_doc: The icon pack's targets: the manager builds mods/atmt_icon_pack.p3a from them on the player's machine
cells of one uncompressed RGBA texture in one or more packages. A changed list marks built packs out of date.
pkg: package paths as the game and SenPatcher name them (all that exist are processed).
texture: the file inside the package. cell_grid: cells per row, so a cell is width / cell_grid
texels whatever size a texture mod made the atlas.
draw_size: the size in 720p-canvas pixels the game draws a cell at (the deckscreen trace gives
it: m00 x 360 for design quads). rows/cols: which cells, counted from the atlas's first stored row
(the game's v = 0, the bottom of the picture); default all. texture_size: [w, h] if the tool
cannot tell it from the file. disabled: true leaves a target out.
original_art: true takes the cells' pictures from the game's own package in the data folder
(the art before any texture mod), pre-shrunk into the modded atlas's cells.
enlarge: true doubles an atlas whose cells are less than 2x draw_size (the game's own 512px icons.png:
32px cells at 20px) until they are not, so the game's own textures get the pre-shrink too.

targets.note: battle status/effect icons: STR/DEF/ATS/ADF/SPD/MOV up/down and the ailment icons
